papers.title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
papers.summary: A reinforcement learning method rewards agents for delaying commitment until their inferred posterior over answers is sufficiently narrow, improving evidence-based answering across vision-language benchmarks.

papers.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
papers.summary: NightWatch adds a lightweight streaming watcher to vision-language computer-use agents to keep perception synchronized with dynamic interfaces, reducing latency and wasted time while maintaining or improving task success.
papers.summary_zh: NightWatch为视觉语言电脑操作智能体加入轻量流式监视器，使感知与动态界面同步，降低延迟并保持或提升成功率。

papers.title: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
papers.summary: We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention effi
papers.summary_zh: 提出Loom注意力，让Transformer在每个token上动态重连电路，将各头的纵向注意力与横向token注意力交织。

papers.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
papers.summary: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while st
papers.summary_zh: 以「像素即代码」为核心的智能体框架，用离散视觉token与结构化代码精确控制图像中的文字与布局。

papers.title: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
papers.summary: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each memb
papers.summary_zh: ACAP将机器人视为由持久智能体组成的团队，通过异步编码智能体在执行中构建和修改机器人行为策略。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
papers.summary: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers to adaptively measure computer-use agents’ capabilities, boundaries, and progress reliability.
papers.summary_zh: CUA-SEE是闭环评测环境，任务与可执行验证器协同演化，自适应衡量电脑操作智能体的能力边界与进展可靠性。

papers.title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
papers.summary: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calc
papers.summary_zh: LingSante MedGuard技术报告，通过核查临床主张与证据、验证计算等，识别医疗AI回复中的有害与不合规内容。

papers.title: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
papers.summary: A training-free agentic framework integrates pretrained 3D and 2D experts with closed-loop refinement to achieve state-of-the-art 3D part segmentation across multiple benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: PartAgent是免训练的智能体式3D部件分割框架，整合3D与2D专家模型并闭环迭代优化，多个基准达到最优。

papers.summary: A new benchmark shows that many robot manipulation policies perform worse when mirrors are present, often because they confuse reflections with real objects rather than simply colliding with the mirror.
papers.summary_zh: 新基准显示加入镜子后许多机器人操作策略表现变差，常因把反射误认为真实物体，而非简单避开镜面。

papers.title: Interpretable Prototype-Conditioned Adaptation for Weather Forecasting
papers.summary: Group-specific prototype banks with cross-variable attention and sparse low-rank corrections improve the accuracy and interpretability of neural weather forecasting by explicitly linking local prototype contributions to prediction errors.
papers.summary_zh: 通过分组原型库、跨变量注意力和稀疏低秩修正，提升神经天气预报的精度与可解释性，明确关联局部原型与预报误差。

papers.title: ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks
papers.summary: A two-stage training approach uses visual pretext tasks to generate interleaved image-text reasoning traces and automatically built demonstrations, improving multimodal reasoning over instruction tuning alone.
papers.summary_zh: ThinkMorph-SSL采用两阶段训练，利用视觉前置任务生成图文交织的推理轨迹与自动示范，提升多模态推理能力。

papers.title: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
papers.summary: An online benchmark evaluates in-context learning across computer-use and robot-use agent tasks, revealing large gaps between digital and physical performance and between recognizing rules and acting on them.
